title: Mayhem in Monsterland
build: Apex disk release, the contributor's own G64 images of both sides; sha256 of each in orientation.md

credits.role: programming ("perfect programming by" in the intro; "programming by" in the ending)
graphics and sound ("gorgeous grafix and superb sounds" in the intro)

tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64 (WSL2) on Windows 11, Ubuntu 26.04.1, Intel Core i7-3770, eight threads, display through WSLg
tools.emulator: own build of github.com/barryw/vice-mcp, release v3.13.2, commit 1e83aab134, built with tools.py get-vice build; driven through kit/c64/vice.py; check-emulator 57 of 57; run with sound off (Sound=0 in tools/vice-home/config/vice/vicerc)
tools.disassembler: regenerator2000 0.9.20, one session for each part
tools.subagents: annotation, audit, checking and page agents on the Agent tool's opus alias, at most four at once: six annotated (three on disjoint engine ranges in one disassembler, one each on the intro, Jellyland and the ending; the lead applied Jellyland's description script to the other four lands), six audited, three checked the verify samples, three built the music player, the maps and the page
tools.simulator: kit/c64/cpu6502.js, for the music driver's port (24 tunes, 0 mismatched frames), the map scroller's column order, the page's mechanic ports and the missed extra life
tools.browser: Google Chrome through the Claude in Chrome extension, for the page checks
